seo.title: RMDevelopers — Offline-first Android apps & games from Pune
seo.description: RMDevelopers is an independent Android studio by Rohit Madas. Explore ArthZen, Local Notes, LaneZing and Patang Pop: private, offline-first apps and games, free on Google Play.
seo.keywords: RMDevelopers, Android apps, offline apps, Indian app developer, ArthZen expense tracker, Local Notes offline notepad, LaneZing bike racing game, Patang Pop kite puzzle, Rohit Madas

hero.sub: We build calm, private, offline-first apps and games for Android. No sign-up walls, no clutter — just tools and play that respect your phone and your time.

stats.label: Apps & games live on Google Play
Offline kite puzzles in Patang Pop

apps.name: ArthZen
apps.tagline: A calmer relationship with your money.
apps.summary: A private, local-first ledger for everyday money. Record income and expenses by hand, set an essential-spending budget, plan your savings and understand it all through simple, explainable summaries — without ever connecting a bank account.
features: Never connects to your bank or reads SMS
Budgets and savings plans with clear arithmetic
Records stored locally, optional cloud backup
Export to CSV or a full backup anytime

apps.name: Local Notes
apps.tagline: Notes that stay on your phone.
apps.summary: A private, offline notepad. Type or dictate, colour-code what matters, attach photos and keep everything on your device. No account, no cloud, no sign-up — and it speaks nine languages.
features: Voice notes in 10 Indian & global languages
Colours, tags, pins and instant search
Works fully offline — no Local Notes server

apps.name: LaneZing
apps.tagline: Twist the throttle. Thread the traffic.
apps.summary: Highway bike racing built for speed. Split lanes between cars, buses and trucks, race superbikes on GP circuits and get muddy on dirt tracks — through day, night and monsoon rain. Plays fully offline.
features: Endless highway, GP circuits and dirt racing
Day, night and monsoon rain on wet roads
Tilt or touch controls, no internet needed

apps.name: Patang Pop
apps.summary: A colourful kite puzzle. Follow each kite's arrow, tap when its path is clear and empty the sky in the right order. 500 hand-shaped offline levels, endless random skies and no time limit — at your own pace.
features: 500 offline puzzles, all in the download
No time limit, free undo, saved hints

principles.title: Offline when it matters
principles.text: Notes, races and puzzles work with no connection. Your phone is the product, not a thin window onto a server.

principles.title: Private by default
principles.text: Records, notes and voice transcripts live on your device. We never read your bank messages or ask for more than a feature needs.

principles.title: Respect for your time
principles.text: No forced sign-ups, no countdown pressure, no maze of menus. Open the app and get on with it.

principles.title: Built for India and beyond
principles.text: Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian and more — apps that speak the way you do.

faq.a: RMDevelopers is the independent Android studio of Rohit Madas, a frontend and mobile engineer based in Pune, India. We design and ship small, private, offline-first apps and games.
Yes. All four are free to download on Google Play. Some are supported by ads, and ArthZen offers an optional Premium plan for deeper analysis and an ad-free experience.

faq.q: Do the apps need an internet connection?
faq.a: Mostly no. Local Notes, LaneZing and Patang Pop work fully offline. ArthZen keeps your records on the device and only goes online for optional cloud backup.
On your phone. Local Notes has no server at all, and ArthZen never connects to your bank. Each app's Google Play listing links to its full privacy policy.

faq.q: How do I report a bug or suggest a feature?
faq.a: Use the developer contact on any app's Google Play listing, or reach out on LinkedIn. Every message is read.
